summary: Audit trail feature tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 38/38 PASS (28 regression + 10 new /api/logs tests). Frontend E2E verified: Dashboard 'Actividad reciente' card + 'Ver todo' link, sidebar 'Historial de accesos' nav, /app/logs empty state for admin medico, and full table+filter+search flow for a seeded paciente with 3 upload + 3 download logs.

minor.issue: Spec says 'vacío para admin/otros'; current code returns all logs ({} query) for non-paciente/clinica/medico roles. Today only 'medico' seeded as admin so effectively empty, but if any future role (e.g. 'admin') is introduced they would see all logs. Consider returning [] for unknown roles.
No brute-force / rate-limit on auth still present (existing).
download logs are written AFTER decrypting but before streaming; if stream fails client-side, log still persists. Acceptable for audit.

issues: 'Cargando historial...' state has no spinner, just plain text — a subtle skeleton/spinner would improve UX.

IP column shows '—' for all local rows because request.client.host resolves to an internal pod IP; behind k8s ingress without X-Forwarded-For header it is not very useful. Consider using request.headers.get('x-real-ip') fallback.

action_items: Optional: return [] from GET /api/logs for roles outside {paciente, clinica, medico} instead of full collection (defense in depth).
Optional: add a spinner icon to Logs.jsx loading state.
critical_code_review_comments: log_access() correctly persists audit entries with actor_id, actor_role, study_id, uploader_id, doctor_id, action and timestamp. Indexes created on study_id, uploader_id, doctor_id, timestamp.
Access control on /api/studies/{id}/logs correctly restricts to uploader or assigned doctor (403 tested).
Dashboard fetches /logs with limit=5 but re-slices on client; small duplication but harmless.
Logs.jsx client-side filter/search is pure-client (filtered = logs.filter(...)); works on the full 200-item page. If list grows large, move filter to backend.
IP resolution prefers X-Forwarded-For first element which is correct for ingress.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (dashboard card, nav, empty state, table, filter upload/download/delete, search match/no-match)

test_credentials: admin@medicos.com / admin123 (medico). E2E paciente seeded per run via /api/auth/register (prefix TEST_e2e_pac_).
seed_data_creation: pytest creates TEST_pac_*, TEST_cli_*, TEST_med_* users and uploads+deletes test DICOM bytes. E2E seed script creates 1 paciente with 3 uploads + 3 downloads against admin medico.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All audit-trail endpoints and UI covered. If main agent changes role semantics, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_dicom_platform.py::TestAccessLogs. Playwright testids used: recent-activity, view-all-logs-link, nav-logs, logs-page, logs-search-input, logs-action-filter, logs-table, log-row-{id}, logs-empty-state, logs-count.
